saturation_assessment.observation: The recent merged/attempted capability units (PR 238 multi-session retention, PR 244 three-round, PR 246 four-round, PR 247 three-learning, PR 248 five-round, PR 249 four-learning, plus the PR 230/233 recursive-frontier and observed-schema line) are dominated by one method family: bounded typed-program synthesis with generated-skill retention probes that vary the round/session count. This is 6/6 same-family in the window of 6 and exceeds the threshold of 4.
saturation_assessment.discriminating_conclusion: Adding more retention-probe variations produces more internal CI-green evidence but does not reduce expected time to the strict external gate, because the gate requires genuinely independent external production evidence and the external ledger throughput is zero. Internal-method variation is gate-irrelevant while no external evaluation channel exists.
saturation_assessment.selected_alternative: Do not merge the near-duplicate retention probes mechanically; integrate at most a representative, non-redundant subset and treat the rest as retained internal evidence. Redirect effort to (a) external-evidence readiness artifacts an independent evaluator could check without trusting this operator, and (b) the user-only evaluator-access request already in the queue. Adopt a materially different internal method only if a scoped comparison shows it lowers expected time to the unchanged gate, not merely to raise internal scores.
saturation_assessment.reevaluate_on: An independent external evaluation channel becomes available, a scoped comparison shows a materially different method lowers expected time to the gate, or the next Root strategy review occurs.
